page.notes: Margin note "Præfectu-ra, & præfecti extraurbe." is split over three lines in the printing; joined here. Doubtful: first word "psius" (the line starts at the page edge, probably "ipsius", read as "psius[?]"); "v. Utrique" (the word before "Utrique" is a dark blotch, so "Utrique" is marked [?]). Running head and printed spelling "Frif." and "Lavic." kept as printed. The faint "Congle" mark at bottom right is a digitiser's watermark and is omitted.
